manifest.name: 应用库
manifest.description: 浏览全部已安装应用，选择放在桌面的作品，不删除应用或数据。

files.index.html:
应用库

打开使用，或添加到桌面。移出桌面不会卸载应用。
files.app.js: (()=>{'use strict';let alive=true,all=[],seq=0,pending=new Map();const list=document.getElementById('list'),search=document.getElementById('search'),status=document.getElementById('feedback');function rpc(action,data={}){return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const id='library-'+(++seq),timer=setTimeout(()=>{pending.delete(id);reject(Error('连接暂时不可用'))},7000);pending.set(id,{resolve,reject,timer});parent.postMessage({type:'atom:library',id,action,data},'*')})}window.addEventListener('message',e=>{if(e.source!==parent||e.data?.type!=='atom:library-result')return;const p=pending.get(e.data.id);if(!p)return;clearTimeout(p.timer);pending.delete(e.data.id);e.data.error?p.reject(Error(e.data.error)):p.resolve(e.data.result)});function render(){if(!alive)return;list.replaceChildren();for(const a of all.filter(a=>(a.name+' '+a.id).toLowerCase().includes(search.value.toLowerCase()))){const row=document.createElement('div');row.className='row';const open=document.createElement('button');open.className='open';const glyph=document.createElement('span');glyph.className='glyph';glyph.innerHTML=a.icon_html;const name=document.createElement('span');name.className='name';name.textContent=a.name;open.append(glyph,name);open.onclick=()=>rpc('launch',{app_id:a.id}).catch(e=>status.textContent=e.message);const pin=document.createElement('button');pin.className='pin';pin.textContent=a.on_desktop?'移出桌面':'放到桌面';pin.disabled=a.id==='app-library';pin.onclick=async()=>{pin.disabled=true;try{await rpc(a.on_desktop?'unpin':'pin',{app_id:a.id});await load()}catch(e){status.textContent=e.message}finally{pin.disabled=a.id==='app-library'}};row.append(open,pin);list.append(row)}document.getElementById('count').textContent=all.length+' 个应用'}async function load(){try{all=(await rpc('list')).apps;render()}catch(e){status.textContent=e.message}finally{AtomApp.ready()}}search.oninput=render;AtomApp.deferReady();AtomApp.onSuspend(()=>{alive=false;for(const p of pending.values()){clearTimeout(p.timer);p.reject(Error('应用已暂停'))}pending.clear()});load()})();
